reviews.text: Very nice people and they take care of my Dog very good she loves it there. Great place for Pet's.
They do a great job with both of my toy poodles. Highly recommended.
Got a full groom for our senior dog and she was taken care of quickly and lovingly- everything was perfect and we cannot thank you enough for taking care of our baby!

I have tried different grooming places but this is the only place that would actually take a good care of my Golden Retriever - Tucker. They never rush grooming him. He always comes home smelling amazing, nice coat and everything is trimmed exactly how I want. We moved away and tried another grooming place. After 1 visit, I decided I would rather drive 40 minutes back to Furrever Love Pet knowing that my Golden Retriever is in good hand!!
Can’t recommend this place enough!
Arlene was excellent with my french angora rabbit named Latte. She turned out so cute.
Arlene was great, she was able to cut our rabbits nail, she did awesome.
Their service is excellent and fair prices , plus they speak Spanish too.
Took my dog for the first time here to be groomed. They did a wonderful job and my dog was very comfortable and happy with the employees.

Great service, professional, and exelent customer service.
👍
First visit. Just a quick nail trim/grind. Quick, reasonable, professional.
Very nice staff and quick grooming

LOVE this team. My pup always looks gorgeous when he's had his "spa day" with Furrever Love, and they do an absolutely amazing job with the deshed process. The price is excellent as well. Highly recommend!

Today I took my little aggressive 7 month old Shih Tzu  in for a much needed grooming and I’m so happy with the results and glad I was recommended by Amy.
My Sadie looked so Beautiful, and other people noticed how beautiful she was and asked where I got her groomed at and I told them, “Furrever Love Pet Grooming “ by Arlene.
Before and After pictures below.

Update: Yes your sister offered to hold my dog. But that’s odd to me, since we were waiting outside. So yes, as a responsible dog owner, the best decision is for me and my dog to wait to gain access to the building. Neither my dog or I are familiar with you, and I will not leave my dog outside alone with a total stranger, where anything could’ve happened. Hopefully no one else will experience anything like this.

I had an 8am grooming with them this morning. Unfortunately, I can’t speak on the service since I didn’t receive it. I show up, and the doors are locked. I called, no one answered. About ten minutes go by, and the sister walked up, apologized and said she didn’t have her keys, but the owner her sister was coming. Ok, I was a little irritated since it’s my first time, but no problem people make mistakes. I waited another ten minutes, and told the sister that I will just stick to grooming him myself. I have the whole install at home, but I don’t want to do it. Then as I am pulling up to my home, the owner messaged me apologizing, and how I can reschedule for later. I don’t get that luxury to reschedule, if it was me running 20+ minutes behind. I would’ve been charged pull price. I wished someone would’ve looked at their system, to see who’s coming in and then reached out about running behind. No one should have to pull up and not have an explanation of what’s going on. No one was rude while speaking, but this is my first interaction with you. I would’ve offered a grooming on me to make this right, not just say to reschedule for a convenient time for me.

The groomers at this establishment are absolutely the best. They go above and beyond. If you love your dog as much as I love mine you wouldn’t go anywhere else! Thank you for the beautiful job you all did on my Bernese Mountain dog.

My Mini Schnauzer looks like a Mini Schnauzer again! Very clean looking. She was a handful, as expected, I let them know. They handled her well and let know what they were able and not able to do with her.
We are very pleased new clients!! My doodle and I will be back. :)
I love this place! Highly recommend!

This was our first time taking our rescue to the groomers, and we had such a great experience! We went with the mini groom, and it was perfect. Everyone was so kind, gentle, and loving with our dog from the moment we walked in, and they explained everything they were going to do. When we picked him up, he was so happy and looked amazing! His coat was soft and shiny, he smelled so good, his ears were super clean, and they even trimmed around his feet. Overall, a great experience and we’ll definitely be back!
My Tillie looks beautiful 😍 …
Love taking my dogs here. The staff is kind and amazing.
Stevie Nick's looks great.

Just moved from out of state and needed to find a new groomer, went out on a whim and booked here. They were awesome! My pup came out looking so handsome and clean! They were quick and super friendly. We have already rebooked and look forward to more visits!
I’ve been to so many groomers before, Furrever is the only groomer who knows exactly what I want for my dogs. Highly recommended.
My furbabies get  groomed  at Furrever Love Pet Grooming and they  look and smell great! We will be returning! 🐕‍🦺🐕‍🦺 ❤️Penny and Pippin ❤️

My dog is a rescue and is not a fan of getting groomed by us or anyone, but you all worked some sort of miracle. You did a fantastic job on him for a very Reasonable price pretty darn quickly (compared to our other experiences). Thank you sooooooooo much!!! You will see us again! 💕💕💕
Great experience!  Thanks for everything, my boy looks so fluffy!!!
They’re the best! Safe and thorough
The dogs look great! They did a great job with them!
First time using their services. Front desk and groomer were very polite and they were very patient with my Great Pyrenees. I really appreciate what they did for her.

Arlene is the best!! I have had a few different groomers, but once I found her, I knew I'd never use anyone else! She use to be a groomer for Brittany's Pet Depot in Katy but now has opened up her own shop here so of course i had to follow 😊 Our miniature schnauzer Kylo is a mega coat, and not all groomers can give them a great haircut, but Arlene, like I said, does great. Never once have I left from picking my fur baby up disappointed! Most  importantly, Kylo loves her ❤️

Kahlua was looking "ruff" before I decided to give Furrever Love a try. She was in between homes and when she found her forever home with us, she desperately needed grooming but was afraid of everyone anyone getting close to her. She did great with the groomers here and they made her feel at ease and were so kind and gentle with her. I'm glad I tried this place out..will definitely be back again. Thanks for taking care of my precious baby! Here are before and after pics 😍

Arlene did an amazing job, extremely happy with the cut she gave my malti-poo!  My little guy was so “happy” when I picked him up…which I never experience after he is groomed!  I was shocked, but VERY pleased!  I plan to return in 8 weeks!  You must try Arlene!

Furrever Love Pet Grooming services are outstanding! They have my fur-baby looking beautiful.
Easy to set appointments, and very professional 🐾❣️🐾❣️ …

My dachshund is 4 and has never been to a groomer. I was probably more anxious than my dog. The staff and owner made me feel at ease and even said I could stay and watch if it helped me feel better. I really appreciate the patience they had answering all my questions and I could tell my dog enjoyed the service. I plan on going back and taking my 2 other dogs there. I would recommend this place!
I love the fact they don't keep your pets too long like other groomers.  In and out in a reasonable time.

I would rate them 100 stars if I could. This was Snickerdoodles third grooming experience at 10 months old. She came in looking pretty shaggy and the hair at her hind legs was pretty wild. Furrever Love took her and turned her into an instant diva with cuteness to boot. Will be bringing our other fur baby, Oliver in when it's his turn to get a haircut and bath. The ladies at Furrever Love really know their stuff about fur babies.

Timely, friendly, pet loving, great groomer!!!
I'll definitely be back!
Very nice, they were all so kind to my dog ​​from the start 🐶 and the work was 10/10, I loved it ♥️ …
My dog is a Pyrenees and tough to groom.  I have been coming here for well over a year.  Arlene and team are awesome!  High quality results and reliably great service.  Highly recommend.

We recently took in our first cat ever and wanted to leave the nail trimming to the professionals. Not all groomers work with cats, but these guys thankfully did and affordably so. We were in and out within 10 minutes. At the time of this review, this cost $15 plus tax.
Absolutely love bringing my baby to get groomed by Arlene!
Furrever pets is truly amazing thank you for being so kind and patient with my angel boy! Y’all are amazing thank you!!
Great service and fast , I think our baby loved it .
Honestly, this might have been the best haircut my Roxie, a Cardigan Welch Corgi, has ever had. I am very pleased and will be returning.
It’s hard to find someone who grooms cats. She always does a fantastic job. I highlight recommended.

Friendly and helpful staff, good prices and quick service... Gypsy was very happy with the experience. She usually doesn't like a bath and having her nails trimmed but this was a good experience for her
Got me in last minute and got my standard poodle washed and trimmed quickly. Great job and thanks for squeezing us in with a difficult dog.

After alot of back and forth with petcos and alot of hits and misses ive decided to give this place a try. Arlene and the other girl were extremely professional and kind. My moms shiztu looks and smell so pretty. Strongly recommend.

I loved everything about my experience! They were patient with me when I booked by appointment. It was my first time and I was nervous but they easily walked me through the steps and gave me the total sum of for my grooming beforehand so I knew how much I needed. As well as being super flexible with the things I forgot to add to my list of wants. They were incredible with my baby Nazareth, they left my husky super soft, smelling wonderful, and beautifully brushed. Now a little note for those who want to get their puppies or dogs groomed here! Please be specific about what you want! Let them know what you're breed is and their behavior/Temperament. Meaning that if your dog is prone to aggression, or doesn't like certain places they don't like to be touched please let them know ahead of time! (it will make it easier on them and you! Use a muzzle!! Remember muzzles are for the animal's safety and yours!)  As well as be sure that they are up to date with their vaccines and provide proof that your puppy or dog is safe to work on!

AMAZING! Arlene never disappoints! She goes above and beyond for our babies! If you have a Great Pyrenees, i definitely recommend her! Arlene, thank you for taking care of our babies the way that you do! Know you are greatly appreciated! ❤️

When Nathan needs a bath and nail trim, he only goes to Furrever love. He really enjoys going there and smells SO GOOD! So soft! Everyone is so nice and sweet to lil Nathan. And I look forward to the Snoopy bandanas. 🤩🤩🤩 …
Winston looks great and not stressed!
I brought Luna here for grooming. The staff was so friendly, and they had great customer service. Luna was a happy pup after her appointment. I recommend. I will be back.
Groomers did a wonderful job. My dog look happy and fresh. Prices are reasonable and turnaround time was great too.

Took my dog in to get his nails trimmed. Owner was polite and explained their services. My dog was very anxious, but she was gentle and understanding my dogs stress and got them all trimmed up beautifully and quickly!

From the moment I arrived to the moment I picked up the puppers, it has been a good experience. Very smooth scheduling process and drop off.

The staff was friendly and what seemed to be very efficient. I dropped them off around 8:00am and they were both ready about an hour and half later.

The price point for the 1st dog who’s a pit mix who weighs about 50lbs was about $60 for a shower, nail trim and cleaning.
For the 2nd dog who’s a blue heeler who weighs about 35lbs was about $95 for a shower, nail trim and haircut.

The staff is transparent with their service and the puppers seemed pretty happy as am I with the service.

It was my little Monty's first visit and he can be a little difficult with new people but he did fine and looked so cute when I picked him up. They had him done in about an hour which I thought was amazing. Monty seemed very happy with the experience so they must have a special touch. Thank you
Always very professional and very nice. Nice and clean facility and my Kitty had a good experience with his bath!

First time taking my Bella and she was a mess since it had been awhile since her last grooming. They were quick and did a great job. Photos are before where she can barely see past her hair and after. We went short because she was a little matted

thanks for taking care of my fur babies, its so nice to have them clean and without sooo much shedding.
Ginger & Pepper ;-)
Attentive from beginning to end, detail-oriented, and excellent service. Very pleased, thank you.

Fantastic experience. My usual groomer wasn’t able to service us at our appointment time and I called Furrever was able to bring my dog in for a bath and nail trim within 30min. He looks and smells great, the most thorough nail trim he’s ever had and he was so happy and not anxious at all. She’s got a solid customer for life now.

I cannot recommend this groomer enough! We have a very anxious German Shepherd with separation anxiety. We tried 2 other groomers that weren’t able to handle his anxiousness, but these ladies were able to get the job done and do it beautifully! ❤️
Our boy looks so handsome! I will definitely be back to see them again!
This was Hazel's first time being groomed! They made her feel very comfortable!!
Amazing job (grooming) with both of my fur-babies! So patient, professional, and courteous😊 thank you for the wonderful customer service! …
My chihuahua is  afraid of the grooming. Furreverlove did an excellent job she is beautiful....

Very nice service, very clean upon walking in
Dog was groomed exactly as I asked
Very pleased

Wanted to come in to get my babies feet and nails trimmed really quickly; it was amazing service!! In and out in 15 mins and he was trimmed up so well!! I’ll definitely be coming back for a full groom :)
The girls are always excellent with my dog. Very cute shop too :)
Wonderful staff, very nice and did a great job grooming my little dog, thank you

They no call, no showed me.

I made an appointment to have my dogs nails cleaned up but when I got to the place, they were closed. Such a shame and a waste of time.

Arlene trimmed my Blue and Gold Macaw's nails and wings today. She was so gentle and thorough. We were very pleased with the results and how affectionate the entire crew is with animals. I would 100% recommend and will definitely be back!
Great experience at Furrever Love Pet Grooming! Took both my mini schnauzers here and they look amazing!! Everyone was super nice and helpful, will definitely be back for all grooming needs!
Love it! My baby smells like a giant blueberry! They are awesome and Bruno loves them!!

This was my Pekingese (Ping) first time to Furrever Love Pet Grooming, and I haven’t seen my baby look this good in months. My groomer retired and I was asking everyone with pets who they used to groom their babies.  I tried 2 different groomers and was not satisfied. Then, I was told about Furrever Love Pet Grooming and took Ping there today (Jan. 13, 2025).  Ping is a special needs Pekingese. They were so sweet and tender with her and were able to do everything with grooming. I am 100% satisfied with this groomer and have now found a permanent groomer for my Ping. I hope if anyone out there needs a groomer, you should try Furrever Love Pet Grooming!!!  They are awesome!!!
Great job with bathing and giving a lion’s cut to 2 Persians. I am so thankful!
The main torta that does the grooming is very rude. We won’t be back.
This is our second time coming here to get our dogs groomed ! They did an excellent job! I will be a returning client.
Great job.
The groomers did a great job with our fur babies! Wonderful customer service! Fast and friendly!
Best place to get your dogs groomed! My dog is always happy to go and has a great time. The ladies at the front desk are always nice. My dog loves them and always recognizes them.

I love how they text and contact you. They always keep you informed and are very timely. They will let you know about cancellations. I’m very particular about their cuts and I can’t tell you how perfect they are. I’m as picky as my own hairdresser 🤣 Highly recommend! …
My pups receive wonderful care and are so spoiled!  Highly recommend.
It was my dogs first time going there for a full grooming and she came back looking amazing! She’s a German shepherd/husky so she has a lot of hair! Def recommend
We love it here! They are always so sweet and loving with our dogs. :) We just moved but will travel back to this location for grooming because they are THAT good!
They’re great! Definitely recommend, my pup comes out looking so good and smelling great! They do an awesome job!
I had a very good experience, so I give them the best rating for the excellent training of the staff and the very good treatment of our pets. Thank you, and I hope they continue doing a great job.
Great experience! We have struggled to find a good groomer in the area. We will definitely be going back!
Sunny Dae looks adorable! You always do such a great jog, thank you!0

We have taken our golden doodle to Furrever Love for quite awhile now, and we’ve had a great experience every time. My pup is always happy to go in and comes out equally happy. Arlene is a talented groomer who truly cares about the animals entrusted to her care. Her sister, who helps her with the business, is very personable and obviously loves animals, as well.
If you have a special needs pet..this is your place. Thank you Arlene for taking good care of our old blind and deaf dog.
My first visit here was great. They had my baby groom in less than 2 hours. Very friendly and nice! My puppy was happy upon pick up!
My pups came out looking younger!
